method: official public HTTP acquisition, full numeric parse of selected TXT tiles; own reading of specified official sections
TXT_update_status: Official catalog: stopped October 2024; retrieved 2026-10-28 JST
parsing: comma-separated256 rows×256columns; e→NaN; units metres; originNW; x east/y south
mosaic: tiles joined by exact x/y indices before derivatives; no filling/missing interpolation

derivation.grid_ground_spacing: 2π*6378137/(2^z*256)*cos(central_latitude), same local metric scale for both axes
derivation.map_display: WebMercator grid uniformly scaled at central latitude, local southwest origin; approximate physical distances
derivation.hillshade: numpy gradient on complete mosaic with physical dx/dy; NW light azimuth315deg altitude45deg; normalized normal dot light; NaN remains masked
derivation.contours: matplotlib contour on original height grid, 500m interval, no zero fill
derivation.profile: full west-east row459 at pixel centers; argmax of selected Fuji mosaic falls on this row
derivation.precision_note: 0.01m text representation is not centimetre measurement accuracy

GML_scope: official specification explanation only: array sizes, startSequence and sequencingRule, class/type and -9999; not a raw file acquired or parsed
